name: hairline-grid
title: Hairline grid
description: Cells divided by single hairlines: no doubled rules, no line on the outer edge, and a short last row that never leaves a grey slot or a stray line.
docs: Put HairlineGridCell elements in a HairlineGrid. columns is a number or a map per breakpoint ({ base: 1, sm: 2, lg: 4 }, a missing breakpoint keeps the one before it); minCell sets the narrowest a cell may get and lets the width decide the number of columns. bordered adds a rounded frame, padding (none, sm, md, lg) is the padding of every cell, and as makes the grid a ul or ol, with as="li" on the cells. A cell with asChild around a link or a button gets a hover tint and an inset focus ring that stay inside its own box. The cells are painted in --hg-cell, which is the page background unless you set it on the grid.
